QuestInfo.name: [Phantom Forest] The Corrupted Forest
QuestInfo.0: NLC's Sheriff Lita has requested your help dealing with strange phenomena that have appeared in the Phantom Forest, to the west of the city. Find out more from her.
QuestInfo.1: NLC's Sheriff Lita has requested your help dealing with strange phenomena that have appeared in the Phantom Forest, to the west of the city. Find out more from her.
QuestInfo.2: There were several reports of people going missing in the Phantom Forest, as well as sightings of living trees and attacks by mysterious red knights. Wait... Who ARE these weird people?
